anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy apply in the report view when the user changes workspace?
A) clear all filters - every switch starts the view unfiltered
B) preserve all active filters - filters carry across switches, as the current workspace-change handler in ui/report-view.ts already does
C) restore each workspace's last filters - each workspace reopens with the filters it had when the user last left it
Recommendation: B - it matches today's handler behavior, so existing users see no change, and it needs no per-workspace filter state beside the resolver-owned setting in settings/resolver.ts:12.
